bookingConfirmed.bodyText: Your reservation {{booking}} is confirmed. We look forward to welcoming you.

paymentConfirmed.heading: Payment confirmed
paymentConfirmed.bodyHtml: We have confirmed your payment of {{amount}} ({{method}}) for booking {{booking}}.
paymentConfirmed.bodyText: We have confirmed your payment of {{amount}} ({{method}}) for booking {{booking}}.
paymentConfirmed.settled: Your booking is fully paid and confirmed. There is nothing left to settle.
paymentConfirmed.outstanding: Your booking is confirmed. The remaining balance is payable at the hotel.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email · {{hotel}}
verifyEmail.preheader: Confirm your email address to finish setting up your {{hotel}} account.
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email
verifyEmail.bodyHtml: Please confirm this is your email address so you can sign in to your account. The link below works for 24 hours.
verifyEmail.bodyText: Please confirm this is your email address so you can sign in to your account. The link below works for 24 hours.

chrome.sealCaveat: This seal is a visual cue only and can be copied. What actually proves this mail is ours is your provider's sender-domain check, and reaching {{host}} by typing it yourself rather than following a link.
chrome.spamNote: If this message is not in your Primary inbox, check Spam and Promotions and mark it as not spam so the next one arrives.

preArrival.subject: Your stay at {{hotel}} begins soon · {{booking}}
preArrival.heading: Your stay begins soon
preArrival.bodyHtml: We look forward to welcoming you. Your stay {{booking}} starts on {{checkIn}}.
preArrival.checkInNote: You can complete online check-in from the link below to skip the front desk.
preArrival.bodyText:
Dear {{name}},
Your stay {{booking}} starts on {{checkIn}}. Room: {{room}}. Check-out: {{checkOut}}.
You can complete online check-in from the link in this email.

birthday.subject: Happy birthday from {{hotel}}!
birthday.preheader: A birthday gift from {{hotel}} is waiting in your wallet.
birthday.heading: Happy birthday
birthday.bodyHtml: Happy birthday! As a thank-you for staying with us, here is your gift.
birthday.walletNote: You can also find it in your guest portal wallet.
birthday.bodyText:
Dear {{name}},
Happy birthday! Your gift is {{gift}}.
Voucher code: {{code}} (valid until {{expiry}}).
Warm wishes,
{{hotel}}

roomAssigned.subject: {{hotel}} · room {{room}} assigned · {{booking}}
roomAssigned.heading: Your room is assigned
roomAssigned.bodyHtml: Your online payment is confirmed and your room has been assigned.
roomAssigned.portalNote: You can also view these details in your guest portal.

receipt.portalNote: You can review your bookings any time in your guest portal.

receiptRequest.heading: Receipt needed
receiptRequest.bodyHtml: Please upload your bank-transfer receipt for booking {{booking}} within 24 hours.
receiptRequest.defaultMessage: Please upload a clear receipt showing the transfer reference and date.
